purpose: Actual human revalidation of the newly reauthored manuscript. Determine real desire-to-read, prose naturalness, suspense, emotional experience, climax and whether prior target-reader failures remain material on the new SHA.

protocol.H1: Read the current manuscript from beginning to end without consulting the Phase365 evaluator report during the read. Record first skim/stop urge, genuine desire-to-continue locations, dialogue/prose reaction, suspense, felt climax, recommendation and whether the work feels like lived fiction or event outline.
protocol.H2: After H1 is frozen, explicitly recheck TR-F01 through TR-F07 on this new SHA as CLOSED / MATERIAL_IMPROVEMENT_BUT_OPEN / STILL_FAILING, with located reasons.

next_after_completion: Coordinator binds the actual human result to the Phase364 manuscript SHA and decides whether failures close, a bounded repair is needed, or final-freeze eligibility can be considered.
